definitions.short: Jerimoth or Jeremoth , the name of twelve Israelites
definitions.usage: Jermoth, Jerimoth, and Ramoth (from the margin).
definitions.full: H3406. Yerimoth or Yeremoth or Yeremoth יְרִימוֺת יְרֵמוֺת, יְרֵימוֺת, proper name, masculine ᵐ5 Αρειμωθ , Ιεριμουθ , etc.; — 1 Benjamites : a. יְרִימוֺת 1Chr 7:7 . b. יְרֵימוֺת 1Chr 7:8 . c. יְרֵמוֺת 1Chr 8:14 . 2 Levites : a. יְרֵמוֺת 1Chr 23:23 . b. id. 1Chr 25:22 = c. יְרִימוֺת 1Chr 24:30 . d. יְרִימוֺת 1Chr 25:4 . e. id. 2Chr 31:13 . 3 id. Naphtalite 1Chr 27:19 . 4 id. son of David and father of Rehoboam's wife 2Chr 11:18 . 5 יְרֵמוֺת , men who had strange wives: a. Ezra 10:26 , ᵐ5 Ιερειμοιθ ( +? ). b. Ezra 10:27 , ᵐ5 Αμων , א Αρμων , A Ιαρμωθ , ᵐ5 L Ιεριμωθ . c. Ezra 10:29 Kt (Qr וְרָמוֺת ), ᵐ5 Μημων , A Ρημωθ , ᵐ5 L Αριμωθ . יִרְמְיָה יִרְמְיָהוּ, see below רמה .
